public_rationale: The claim says every single major bank and financial institution has put hundreds of millions or billions into data centers that are slow to earn money and then 'only seem to lose it.' Large banks clearly are lending heavily to AI data centers. For example, JPMorgan, MUFG, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs and others joined a $38 billion construction loan. But 'every single major bank and financial institution' has no defined membership to check. And 'seem to lose it' is a hedged impression, not a firm claim that the projects lose money. Grading it as a firm loss claim would strip out his qualifier. Grading it as an impression leaves nothing to test. Project-level profits are also not public. The claim is rhetorical in form and has no testable plain reading, so it is not graded.
limitations: The financing part is broadly consistent with public deal reports, but that alone does not test the claim as written.

statement.excerpt: Every single major bank and financial institution has piled hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars into building data centers that take forever to even start generating money, at which point they only seem to lose it.

our_interpretation: The claim has two parts: that every major bank and financial institution has put at least hundreds of millions into data center construction, and that those data centers take a long time to earn money and then 'seem' to lose it.
'Every single major bank and financial institution' names no defined set, so the universal cannot be checked institution by institution.
'Only seem to lose it' is an impression, not a firm claim that the projects are loss-making. Treating it as a firm loss claim would drop his hedge.
Project-level revenue and profit for bank-financed data centers are generally not public.
criteria.support_condition: Would require a defined list of major banks and institutions each shown to have committed hundreds of millions or more to data center construction, plus public operating results showing the financed facilities lag on revenue and then run losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Would require a clearly major bank shown to have no meaningful data center exposure, or financed AI data centers shown to earn money quickly and profitably.
